mapper.sql: FROM product_spu spu INNER JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.spu_id = spu.id AND sku.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_sku_stock ss ON ss.sku_id = sku.id

mapper.select:
SELECT spu.id AS spuId, MAX(spu.name) AS spuName, MAX(spu.pic) AS pic, MAX(spu.brand_name) AS brandName, MAX(spu.category_name) AS categoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT sku.id) AS skuCount, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ss.stock, 0)), 0) AS totalAvailableStock, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ss.lock_stock, 0)), 0) AS totalLockStock, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ss.sale, 0)), 0) AS totalSale, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.low_stock, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(ss.stock, 0) <= COALESCE(ss.low_stock, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS warningSkuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.stock, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS emptySkuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.stock_status, 0) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS presaleSkuCount
GROUP BY spu.id
AND COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.low_stock, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(ss.stock, 0) <= COALESCE(ss.low_stock, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0
AND COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.stock, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0
AND COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.stock_status, 0) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0
ORDER BY MAX(COALESCE(ss.update_time, sku.update_time, spu.update_time)) DESC, spu.id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS spuCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.skuCount), 0) AS skuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.warningSkuCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS warningSpuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.emptySkuCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS emptySpuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.presaleSkuCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS presaleSpuCount FROM ( SELECT spu.id AS spuId, COUNT(DISTINCT sku.id) AS skuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.low_stock, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(ss.stock, 0) <= COALESCE(ss.low_stock, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS warningSkuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.stock, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS emptySkuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.stock_status, 0) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS presaleSkuCount
GROUP BY spu.id ) t

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS `all`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.warningSkuCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `warning`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.emptySkuCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `empty`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.presaleSkuCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `presale` FROM ( SELECT spu.id AS spuId, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.low_stock, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(ss.stock, 0) <= COALESCE(ss.low_stock, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS warningSkuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.stock, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS emptySkuCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.stock_status, 0) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS presaleSkuCount
GROUP BY spu.id ) t
